before: A host could only intercept Enter and Backspace by listening to keydown in the capture phase, which an input method's beforeinput never passes through.
after: An edit policy installed on the editor is asked before every paragraph break and deletion, from keydown and from beforeinput, and can take the edit over.
reason: The policy only decides which ops a keystroke produces; whatever a host writes in its place goes through the same op lanes the journal already replicates.
